---
title: "Dog Rabies, Central African Republic, 2003–2012"
---

## Overview

This dataset documents dog rabies cases in the Central African Republic from 2003 to 2012. It includes a linelist of confirmed cases with geographic coordinates, and associated DNA sequence data for phylogenetic analysis of rabies virus strains.

## Source

Institut Pasteur de Bangui; WHO Collaborating Centre for Rabies.

## Data

The dataset is returned as a `NamedTuple` with two components:

- **linelist**: index, date, latitude, longitude, has_dna
- **dna**: DNA sequences as a DataFrame

```{julia}
using Outbreaks
using DataFrames
data = Outbreaks.rabies_car_2003()
linelist = data.linelist
dna = data.dna
```

### Linelist

```{julia}
first(linelist, 6)
```

```{julia}
describe(linelist)
```

### DNA sequences

```{julia}
first(dna, 6)
```
